public_study_information.text: All molecules are anti-IL-2Rgamma VHHs in the same monovalent VHH-Fc format. Human KD values are the printed Table 23 values against recombinant human IL-2Rbeta-gamma extracellular-domain reagent P1AE2657. These were measured on a Biacore 8K at 25 C, capturing VHH-Fc on an anti-PGLALA CM3 surface, using receptor as analyte and a 1:1 Langmuir fit. The benchmark neutral-pH label is 7.5. No numerical cynomolgus results are printed in this table; those fields remain unavailable. Cell binding was measured on human IL-2Rbeta-gamma Bioassay cells with antibody incubation for 60 min at 4 C and anti-human-Fc PE median-fluorescence detection. The hidden retention endpoint uses all 11 positive observed concentration columns from the published figure, excluding the separately plotted zero-dose control. Concentrations are digitized approximate chart coordinates rather than an asserted exact serial-dilution recipe. Parent, variant and DP47 curves are always matched within the same panel. Ranking is scored only on differences robust to conservative curve-reading and log-dose-coordinate uncertainty; unresolved pairs are not forced into an experimental total order.
